candidates: IaC template environment block for CrudApiFunction
answer.explanation: From 17:52:06 onward, every CrudApiFunction invocation that calls add_product fails with AccessDeniedException for dynamodb:PutItem on arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-north-1:708553018645:table/missing-table, at about 35-42 errors per minute. The 16:00–17:52 window shows no ERROR or AccessDenied lines, so the failure began abruptly at the start of the window. The denied resource is the table name the function is configured to use, so the function's table-name configuration appears to have changed to a non-existent or unauthorised table. The most likely root cause is that environment variable, which points the Lambda at 'missing-table'. The role denial is a symptom, because the execution role has no grant on that resource. I could not read the live function configuration, the role policy or the IaC template with the available tools, so the exact variable name and whether the IaC template itself changed are not verified. The other three functions show only normal REPORT lines with no errors. No alarms are active.
